title: Google’s search monopoly is becoming an AI monopoly
description: Google's search crawler now feeds its artificial intelligence models, creating an unfair advantage. This strategy accelerates automated internet traffic, surpassing human activity online. Regulators and industry players are pushing for changes to this practice. Google will now allow websites to opt out of AI data usage without search ranking penalties. This shift aims to ensure original content creators are still rewarded for their work.
